lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters (approximately 15-25 pixels in diameter) arranged in a semi-regular grid across the visible mid-lateral flank, bounded anteriorly by the gill region and ventrally by the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross horizontal lines of luminance, forming anchor nodes where high-intensity circular blobs are positioned.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to low-intensity shadow on the ventral side of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of small, high-luminance teleost-like objects (baitfish) distributed across the foreground and mid-ground, causing localized occlusions of the shark's primary lateral patterning and pectoral fin surface.
